latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of highlight-editor-photo skill, enabling fast AI highlight video creation from user-uploaded photos.
- Allows uploading JPG, PNG, HEIC, or WEBP files (up to 200MB) and generating highlight reels with music, transitions, and various export formats.
- Automatic session and token handling for seamless backend API connection.
- Supports essential workflows: file upload, video generation via prompt, preview timeline, check credits, and export.
- Clear error messaging and support for both free (anonymous) and registered user flows.
- Designed for quick, no-learning-curve creation of slideshow videos for social media and personal highlights.
